summary: Backend: 14/14 pytest PASS (tests/test_tasks_cpd_socials.py). 1) Hidden test users: GET /users returns 32 users, without Alex Admin or Erin Employee and with Ailis/Clair; the test tokens still log in. 2) Tasks: an employee task with no assignee is private:true and visible only to that employee. Employee DELETE of an admin-assigned task -> 404, but PATCH done works. Validation returns 400. 3) CPD: POST/GET/DELETE work and year_hours updates. Admin scope=all returns team_totals. Employee scope=all falls back to their own logs. Validation (date, hours 0, empty title) -> 400. Resources: employee POST/DELETE -> 403; admin add (url normalised to https://) / list / delete works. 4) Socials: links, configured:false for both, posts [], redirect_uris shown to admin only. meta/linkedin start -> 409 for admin and 403 for employee. 5) iteration_9 regression FIXED: setting the shared folder indexed docs; DELETE shared-folder -> drive_docs=0, drive_pins=0, /drive/shared 409. Socials tab shows 3 cards (343x72), each opens its profile in a new tab; 'No posts yet' and the admin connect note route to Integrations; Integrations shows 'Social media' with 'Waiting for app credentials' for both. Employee task: + -> 'New private task' -> save -> 'Only you' + lock -> delete via confirm sheet. Admin compose has Everyone / Just me / 30 people (no Alex/Erin). Team directory shows the new staff with group badges and no test users. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch). No page errors.

Admin can change the status of any task, including another user's private task (no private/assignee check for admins).
Returns 200 {ok:true} even when the resource does not exist (no 404).
team_totals includes hidden test users (Erin Employee showed in Team hours). It only lists staff who have logs, so staff with 0 hours are not visible to the admin.

rca_of_issue: AI 'Armi Myers' mention after the folder was cleared: drive_docs is empty and drive_context returns ''. The leak comes from ask_ai including the last 8 ai_messages, which still hold an earlier Drive-based answer. Reproduce: ask about timesheets while the folder is set, clear the folder, ask again -> the model mentions the earlier names. Mitigation: clear ai_messages on folder clear/change, or add a system note.
